deckIntent: A systematic analysis of the climate tech landscape through the lens of Swiss design precision. Dense information grids carry the analytical weight, while asymmetric compositions highlight key market dynamics. Visual content focuses on clean architectural diagrams of technology systems and stark data presentations. The deck alternates between information-heavy analysis and dramatic thesis statements, creating a rhythm that mirrors the urgency and complexity of climate innovation.

cards.cardInstructions: Single-column-positioned: H1 title 'Climate Tech 2025' positioned bottom-left. Optional metadata line 'Market Analysis — January 2025'. Clean, declarative opening with ample negative space above. Dark background (#1A1A1A) with white text for dramatic contrast.

Dense-grid: 3-column analysis of climate tech market fundamentals. Left column: '**Market Size** The global climate tech market reached $1.2T in 2024...' Middle column: '**Investment Flow** Venture capital deployment shifted toward...' Right column: '**Policy Drivers** Regulatory frameworks in EU and US...' Each column 2-3 paragraphs with bold sub-headers. Comprehensive market overview.

Asymmetric-info: Left column — prose analysis of energy storage breakthrough trends, battery cost curves, and grid integration challenges (2 paragraphs, 60 words). Right column — H1 thesis 'Storage solves everything.' right-aligned, bottom-anchored. The headline captures the sector's central bet.

Image+text: Left column — include a <DIAGRAM> showing clean renewable energy system architecture (solar, wind, storage, grid integration). Right column — prose analysis of infrastructure scaling challenges and grid modernization requirements (2 paragraphs, 80 words).

Dense-grid: 3-column deep dive into sector challenges. Left column: '**Capital Intensity** Hardware-heavy climate solutions require...' Middle column: '**Regulatory Risk** Policy uncertainty creates deployment friction...' Right column: '**Technical Barriers** Materials science limitations in carbon capture...' Each column 2-3 paragraphs. The analytical backbone of sector headwinds.

Pull-quote: Left column — H1 quote '72% of climate startups cite scaling manufacturing as their primary barrier.' Right column — context on why manufacturing bottlenecks define the sector, citing recent Breakthrough Energy report and venture partner insights (2 paragraphs, 50 words).

Data+context: Left column — prose on venture capital trends and corporate strategic investments in climate tech (2 paragraphs, 70 words). Right column — key stats: $48B deployed in 2024, 23% increase in Series B rounds, top 3 subsectors by funding volume.

Heading+grid: H1 section title 'Opportunity Vectors' at top. 3 columns below: Left — '**Carbon Removal** Direct air capture scales with...' Middle — '**Industrial Heat** Steel and cement decarbonization...' Right — '**Mobility** Commercial vehicle electrification...' Each column H4 heading + 2 paragraphs on market opportunity.

Single-column-positioned: H1 statement 'The climate window demands industrial-scale deployment.' positioned bottom-right. Captures the urgency imperative. Clean typography against white background, contrasting with opening card's dark treatment.
